intro: Randis is a spirited young human orphan under the care of Orphan Matron Nightingale at the orphanage in Cathedral Square. During Children's Week, he eagerly accompanies willing adventurers across the Alliance's territories to take in sights far beyond the city walls.

p: Residing in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Randis is one of many children left without family in the wake of the realm's persistent conflicts. When the annual Children's Week arrives, Orphan Matron Nightingale entrusts sympathetic heroes with a whistle to take him under their wing. Full of youthful curiosity and nonstop questions, Randis dreams of adventuring, asks endless riddles, and boldly declares that when he grows up, he wants to be the king of Stormwind.

For a boy who spends most of his days penned up in Cathedral Square, leaving the capital is a grand adventure. Though he is quick to note that places like Ironforge smell rather odd, his boundless wonder reflects the innocent future that heroes of the Alliance fight to protect.
